payload.title: Which practice reviews a build run's final candidate within budget, without chaining on small changes?
payload.body: Today: hyp prompt stops a run at 5 Results per actor, and hyp-goal-run asks one review per candidate. --limit exists only on hyp record, so a review became its own Experiment: a gate plus a review cost two. Runs 1 to 3 of G-ZBM2RE (issue #141) ended with the last candidate unreviewed. Separating scenario: replay each practice from the cuts after R-8JQPWG (one Experiment left, a fix pending), R-3YJ7T2 (both probes pass) and R-JHBCWS (a review finds only passing cases), 3 trials each, and read how each run stops. Each rival is a whole practice.

why: The one question of the Goal, owner-confirmed in the grill.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Result carries the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Experiment again. Run 3 did this unprompted for 04142f3 (E-GE085A).

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: keep the practice; the stop checkpoint names each unreviewed candidate
payload.body: The gap is visible to the owner. Run 2 did it without a rule; the scenario also checks whether it holds when the runner has no earlier gap to learn from. It must hold alone.

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Experiment left, review the current candidate, not another fix
payload.body: The run reviews the candidate it has, stops with the findings recorded as limits, and names what it did not fix. On run 2's cut both probes passed on 2284172, so a Result closing them followed by the select would have ended reviewed.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: An edit to the default in internal/cli/prompt.go, for example 5 to 7, so the hyp sha256 differs from the base (a bare --experiments flag would not). Owner's note: run 2 had a fresh budget of 5 and still ended unreviewed, because each review led to a new commit.

payload.body: A limit stays for a case no check ran, or one the candidate fails. N1 and P1 of run 3 close on 3cfd08d and d2d5d14 and no commit follows. The rest of the budget text stays as the base.
